body: One related issue I noted is that it seems the convention on macOS at least is that unlike Godot applications generally do not show hover tooltips for windows that are in the background. Most AppKit controls still react visually to mouse over hover effects while the window is in the background but it seems being in the background prevents the delayed appearance of hover tooltips. While this might be for UX reasons since the user probably is not actively interested in background windows it also has the benefit of avoiding opening and closing new child windows for the tooltips while in the background. Conforming to this convention in Godot as well would also likely solve this reordering issue as no child windows would open and close.
